analyze_match_table: analyze the ARM match table file to extract instruction mnemonics and their carry/predication flags
run_analyze_match_table_cli: run the script with an ARMGenAsmMatcher.inc file path to print mnemonic flag combinations
run_analyze_match_table_auto: run the script without arguments to auto-detect the LLVM object root and analyze the ARM match table
review_analyze_match_table: review the analyze_match_table function that parses LLVM ARM instruction match entries
summarize_main: summarize the main CLI entry point that resolves the input file and calls analyze_match_table
